mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the current month reduces discount rates applied to corporate cash flows, lowering the present value of future earnings and thus driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite sustained FEDFUNDS > 5.25% for 3 consecutive months, or 60-day IC exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4% trigger a contractionary labor market that increases uncertainty, reducing expected equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns turn positive when UNRATE crosses above 4%, or IC > 0.04 over a 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) relative to GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong consumer demand, which anticipates higher corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2% while GDPC1 growth rate < 1%
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative despite sustained CPIAUCSL/GDPC1 > 1.5 for 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing capacity, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when INDPRO recovers to > 105 within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in FEDFUNDS turns positive (signaling tightening), the S&P 500 exhibits negative 20-day forward returns unless offset by a simultaneous 10%+ rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL).
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive with FEDFUNDS up and CPIAUCSL also up.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained declines in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over 3 months indicate labor market strength that boosts business hiring and corporate profits, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns flat or negative when UNRATE remains below 3.5 for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of accelerating home sales ( proxy via HOUST) above 1,200 units suggest resilient consumer confidence and anticipate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative when HOUST falls below 1100 within 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 (index) for 4 consecutive months indicates a deepening supply-side weakness that depresses growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive when INDPRO recovers to > 100 within 8 weeks.
